title: Vickers Wellington HF570
memorial_details: description: IN MEMORY OF/ (names)/ WHO DIED NEAR THIS SPOT IN THE CRASH OF/ WELLIGTON BOMBER HF570/ ON THE 5TH OF SEPTEMBER 1944/ AND OF THEIR UNSELFISH, GALLANT SACRIFICE/ IN THE CAUSE OF FREEDOM./ THESE MEN WERE MEMBERS OF BOMBER COMMAND, 84 OPERATIONAL TRAINING UNIT/ BASED AT RAF DESBOROUGH./ WE ALSO RECOGNISE THE SACRIFICE OF/ OTHER AIRMEN WHO LOST THEIR LIVES/ DURING TRAINING AT RAF DESBOROUGH
